newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks seen higher on dollar.
newsitem.headline: French stocks seen higher on dollar.

text.p: French shares were seen opening higher, boosted by a firmer dollar and gains on Wall Street, on an upward stretch of a roller-coaster ride that has been going on for many days, dealers said.

The April CAC-40 future traded 27 points, or 1.05 percent, higher at 2,590 at 0718 GMT. On Monday the CAC had closed modestly lower, after having started with a sharp fall, following Wall Street's moves.

LVMH reported a rise in its first quarter sales to 10.86 billion francs from 6.46 billion francs. But this reflected the acquisition of DFS and on a like-for-like basis the rise would have been 10.4 percent.
